allyfast.description:
AllyFast is a beautifully crafted intermittent fasting timer built with SwiftUI.
Clean, lightweight, and privacy-first. Whether you follow 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, or extended fasts, AllyFast keeps your fasting journey simple and focused.
                                                            
Why AllyFast?                                 
                                                                                  
• No subscriptions. One-time $0.99. Yours forever.                              
• 100% private. All data stays on your device.
• No ads, no trackers, no accounts, no clutter.                                 
• Ultra lightweight at just 1.7 MB.                                             
                                                                                  
Key Features                                                                    
                                                                                
• Beautiful fasting timer with smooth SwiftUI animations
• Supports intermittent fasting plans: 12:12, 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD
• Extended fasts up to 72 hours
• Editable fasting history with color-coded goal tracking
• Science-based fasting stage insights (fed state, ketosis, autophagy, and more)
• Unlimited local import and export of your fasting data
• Polished for iOS 26 Liquid Glass
• Full Dark Mode support                       
                                                                                  
Perfect Privacy                                                                 
                                                                                
Your fasting data never leaves your iPhone. No cloud sync, no servers, no tracking. Just you and your fast.                         
                                                                                  
Built for Everyone                                                              
                                                                                
From beginners exploring their first 16:8 fast to experienced fasters tracking multi-day autophagy windows, AllyFast adapts to your goals without getting in the way.                                                                        
                                                            
No cloud. No noise. Just fasting.

allymetronome.description:
AllyMetronome is a fast and precise digital metronome designed for musicians who want a clean and reliable practice tool.

Inspired by classic hardware metronomes, AllyMetronome focuses on clarity, simplicity, and accurate timing so you can stay locked in while practicing.

Key Features

• Tempo range from 30 to 252 BPM
• Tap tempo for quick adjustments
• Preset button to cycle common time signatures (4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 6/8, 9/8, 5/4, 7/8)
• Beat value selector for /4 and /8 denominators
• Tappable 3-level accent system (high, medium, low) for custom beat patterns
• Multiple subdivisions including 8th notes, triplets, and 16th notes
• Flexible meter from 0 to 9 beats per bar
• Standard, Loud, and Woodblock click sounds
• Settings to show or hide Tap, Preset, and Meter/Beat controls
• Clean, distraction-free interface
• Studio-quality metronome timing

Designed for guitarists, pianists, drummers, and music students, AllyMetronome helps you keep perfect time during practice and performance.

allymetronomelite.description:
AllyMetronomeLite is a fully working digital metronome for everyday music practice, with the vintage-inspired look of classic hardware.

Set your tempo, tap along and keep time with a synchronized pendulum and clear click sounds.

FEATURES
• Tempo range from 30 to 252 BPM
• Tap tempo for quick adjustments
• Meters 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4
• Presets for 4/4, 3/4 and 2/4
• Eighth-note, triplet and sixteenth-note subdivisions
• Tappable high, medium and low accents
• Standard, Loud and Woodblock click sounds
• Settings to show or hide Tap, Preset and Meter controls
• Landscape interface with a synchronized pendulum
• Saved settings for your next practice session

LITE EDITION
Lite uses a fixed quarter-note (/4) beat value and supports up to four beats per bar. There is no BEAT selector. Meter 0 provides an unmetered click.

For meters up to 9, /8 beat values and additional time-signature presets, the Unlock all features button opens information about the separate full AllyMetronome app on the App Store.

No account or sign-in is required.

allyclock.description:
AllyClock turns your iPhone or iPad into the clock it deserves to be: a big, beautiful, fullscreen time display that looks great on a desk, a nightstand, or a shelf.

Two faces, both live and adjustable:

FULLSCREEN
The time in large, thin digits with seconds ticking quietly beside them. Weekday, date, and time zone sit underneath on a clean baseline. Toggle seconds, weekday, zone, GMT offset, and the flag to make it yours.

WORLD CARDS
The cities you care about, each on its own card: flag, local time, date, and GMT offset. Add up to twelve cities, break them into rows, and scale the time and date independently.

DESIGNED TO DISAPPEAR
Controls fade away after a moment, leaving only the time. Tap anywhere to bring them back. Every change applies live: close a panel any way you like and your changes stick.

MADE FOR LANDSCAPE
AllyClock is built for iPhone and iPad in landscape, with a companion web version at allyclock.netlify.app.

allypiano.description:
AllyPiano is a real piano in your pocket, not a toy.

Play a concert grand voiced from real recordings, sampled every minor third across all 88 keys. Or switch to Midnight: a glowing, detuned synthwave keyboard with silky filters and space.

The keyboard feels right under your fingers. Play chords with as many fingers as you have. Sweep across the keys for a glissando that lands exactly where you touch. Slide the wooden rail to travel the full 88 keys, or center the keyboard on any note you like.

Make it yours: zoom the keys to your hand, show or hide note names, resize the labels. Everything you set is remembered.

FEATURES
• Full 88-key piano, A0 to C8
• Concert grand from real samples. Every note rings true.
• Midnight: a synthwave keyboard with detuned warmth and glow
• Multi-touch chords and fingertip glissando
• Sustain pedal latch
• Adjustable key size, centered note, and labels
• Works completely offline. Samples are built in.
• No ads. No subscriptions. No accounts. No data collected. Ever.

Made for iPhone and iPad, in landscape: the way a piano should be.
